[[Margonite Anur Mank]] are the elite [[Margonite]] shooting rangers. They are found in the elite area [[Domain of Anguish]]. They follow the orders of [[Mallyx the Unyielding]]. They are guarding the City of Torc'qua from intruders, standing above the walls.
